item.description: UBTECH has started delivering UWorld U1 Lite, Pro and Ultra companion humanoids to Chinese buyers after a June launch that logged more than 13,000 orders.

item.description: Doubao's consumer phone assistant prioritizes MCP and A2A protocol calls to apps, keeping GUI-agent automation as a SAEP-bounded fallback rather than the default path.

item.title: US Proposes AI Incident Alert System in Talks With China, Bessent Says
item.description: Trump has resisted calls to slow down AI development, saying that would help China catch up to U.S. companies. The post US Proposes AI Incident Alert System in Talks With China, Bessent Says appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.description: Xiaomi open-sourced MiMo-V2.6-Pro and Flash weights with RL code and 7,000-plus task environments, focusing on downloadable checkpoints rather than the prior livestream dashboard story.

item.title: Light Origins Open-Sources Light-O1-Preview 6B Whole-Body Model
